svg.text: Video in, decisions out: everything runs inside the store; only small anonymous events are stored.
Raspberry Pi 5 today → Qualcomm Dragonwing QCS6490 NPU next
• Door-to-counter forecast (Erlang-C): “open counter 3 in ~6 min” before the queue forms
• Lost-sales ₹: shopper dwells at an EMPTY slot → revenue at risk
• Camera ⊕ weight ⊕ ToF: hidden depletion, loose-grain bins, shrink flags
• ACT → MEASURE → LEARN: checks whether the alert actually cut the wait
Frames live only in RAM · events ≈ 200 bytes · replay mode for testing on recorded video
STM32 → edge node over UART / RS-485
